title: Pip and Tumble's Sink-or-Float Rescue
moral: Kind friends always find a way to help, even the littlest ones.
description: A teeny ladybug named Dot is stuck on a rock in the middle of Lily Pond! To help her, Pip, Tumble and Nana Hoot need a boat that floats, so they test a rock, an apple, a spoon and a leaf. Learn what sinks and what floats in this funny, kind animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: One sunny morning, Pip and Tumble skipped down to Lily Pond for Splash Day! Splishy-splashy!
Then they heard a teeny, tiny voice... Help! Help!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Who said that? Is it a talking fish? A singing sock?
No, silly! It was a little ladybug called Dot, stuck on a rock in the middle of the pond!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! Poor Dot! The water is too deep for her!

popups.sub: stays on top of the water

narration.text: BOING! Nana Hoot landed beside them. Her glasses slipped right down her beak. Wibble-wobble!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! To reach Dot, we need a little boat. And a boat must FLOAT.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Float? What's a float, Nana? Is it a kind of cake?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! No, Pip. Things that float stay up on top of the water.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: And things that sink go down, down, down to the bottom. Can you say it with me? FLOAT! SINK!

narration.text: First, Pip picked up a big, round rock.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Rocks are super-duper floaty! I just know it! Watch this!
PLOP! The rock went down, down, down... glug, glug, glug!
Did the rock float or sink? What do you think?
It SANK! Great job, friends! Rocks are heavy, so they sink.
Then Pip slipped on the squishy mud. Wheeeee... BONK! Right on his fluffy tail!
Next, Tumble held up a shiny red apple from the picnic basket.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: This apple is big and round. It will sink for sure!
PLOP! In it went. And then... bob... bob... bob!
Look closely! Is the apple floating or sinking?
It FLOATS! The apple bobbed on top of the water, like a tiny red duck!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! I guessed wrong!

narration.text: They tested more things. A spoon? PLOP! It sank. A stick? It floated! A green leaf? It floated too!
Let's count the things that floated. The apple, the stick, the leaf! One, two, three!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Leaves float! We need a GIANT leaf for a boat. A boaty-floaty-leafy-thing! I'll jump for one!
Boing! Too low. Boing! Still too low. Ka-BONK! Pip bounced right off Tumble's tummy!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Hee-hee! That tickles! Here, let me help.
Tumble reached up, up, UP with his long trunk and picked the biggest leaf of all.

narration.text: They made a leaf boat with a stick and a pink petal sail. Did it float? YES! Hooray!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: But how do we get it all the way to Dot?
Tumble blew with his trunk. Fwoooo... The boat moved only a teeny bit.
Then a fluffy dandelion seed tickled Tumble's trunk. Uh-oh... you know what happens next, don't you?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO!
ZIP! The little boat zoomed across the pond and stopped right next to Dot!
Dot climbed onto the boat, and Tumble blew a gentle, gentle breeze to bring her safely home.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Welcome back, Dot! You're all wet. Come and get cosy on my soft green scarf.
Tumble shared a slice of the floaty apple, and Dot giggled a teeny ladybug giggle.
And Nana Hoot? She had dozed off. Zzzzz...

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! Did somebody say apple? Hoo-hoo-HOO!
